issue_context.title: Source name containing "/" breaks HomeKit
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I have successfully integrated a Sony Bravia TV into Home Assistant and HomeKit. Unfortunately the source name 
"HDMI 2/MHL" is somehow transformed into "HDMI 2-MHL" in the source selection within HomeKit.

When I select that source the TV will not change into that source and will not respond to any other source selection requests within HomeKit until I power cycle the device. Any ideas?

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2023.1.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Media Player, Home Kit

review_comments: this check is not ideal, as any key that is cleaned up will now cause this to be re-generated every time.

We only hit this logic if the source is missing in `_async_update_input_state` (after the accessory is set up)

https://github.com/bdraco/home-assistant/blob/2fd48a5bf78c96351431fc35f56c073dfc151cf7/homeassistant/components/homekit/type_remotes.py#L188

In that case we are likely in for a full accessory reset and rebuild anyways since the source list has to be exported when the accessory is created.

https://github.com/bdraco/home-assistant/blob/2fd48a5bf78c96351431fc35f56c073dfc151cf7/homeassistant/components/homekit/type_remotes.py#L205
